units.en: Qing was mild and refined rather than cruel; in every prefecture or command he inspired both respect and affection, and when he died people deeply mourned him.
units.literal: Qing's nature was mild and refined and not cruel; whenever he governed a prefecture or commanded troops he inspired both fear and affection, and when he died people deeply regretted his loss.

units.zh: 子彥弼，在太原日，因頃走歸梁朝，武皇怒，下蠶室加熏腐之刑，後籍於內侍省，卒焉。
units.en: His son Yanbi, while the family was at Taiyuan, was punished because Qing had fled to the Liang: the Martial Emperor in his rage sent him to the castration ward and had him emasculated; he was later registered in the Palace Domestic Service and died there.
units.literal: His son Yanbi, while at Taiyuan, because Qing had fled to the Liang court, incurred the Martial Emperor's wrath; he was sent to the silkworm chamber and subjected to castration by fumigation, later was registered in the Palace Domestic Service, and died there.

units.zh: 周光輔，太原人，後唐蕃漢馬步總管、幽州節度使德威之長子也。
units.en: Zhou Guangfu of Taiyuan was the eldest son of Dewei, Later Tang overall commander of tribal and Han cavalry and infantry and military governor of You Prefecture.
units.literal: Zhou Guangfu of Taiyuan was the eldest son of Dewei, Later Tang overall commander of tribal and Han cavalry and infantry and military governor of You Prefecture.

units.zh: 德威，有傳在《唐書》。
units.en: Dewei has a biography in the 《Book of Tang》.
units.literal: Dewei has a biography in the 《Book of Tang》.

units.zh: 光輔年甫十歲，補幽州中軍兵馬使，有成人之志，德威以牙軍委之，麾下鹹取決焉。
units.en: Guangfu was only ten when appointed Youzhou central army troops and horses commissioner; he showed the spirit of a grown man, and Dewei entrusted the tooth army to him—all under his command deferred to his decisions.
units.literal: Guangfu was only ten when appointed Youzhou central army troops and horses commissioner; he showed the spirit of a grown man, and Dewei entrusted the tooth army to him—all under his command deferred to his decisions.

units.zh: 及長，體貌魁偉，練於戎事。
units.en: When he grew up he had a tall and imposing physique and was practiced in military affairs.
units.literal: When he grew up he had a tall and imposing physique and was practiced in military affairs.

units.zh: 父卒，授嵐州刺史，從莊宗平梁，遷檢校尚書左僕射、汝州防禦使，仍賜協謀定亂功臣。
units.en: After his father's death he was made prefect of Lan, followed Zhuangzong in pacifying Liang, was transferred to Acting Left Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat and defensive commissioner of Ru Prefecture, and was granted the title Meritorious Minister of Cooperative Counsel and Pacifying Rebellion.
units.literal: After his father's death he was made prefect of Lan, followed Zhuangzong in pacifying Liang, was transferred to Acting Left Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat and defensive commissioner of Ru Prefecture, and was granted the title Meritorious Minister of Cooperative Counsel and Pacifying Rebellion.

units.zh: 天成初，移汾州。
units.en: At the beginning of Tiancheng he was transferred to Fen Prefecture.
units.literal: At the beginning of Tiancheng he was transferred to Fen Prefecture.

units.zh: 四年，入為右監門衛大將軍。
units.en: In the fourth year he entered court as Grand General of the Right Gate Guard Army.
units.literal: In the fourth year he entered court as Grand General of the Right Gate Guard Army.

units.zh: 長興、清泰中，歷陳、懷、磁三郡，繼加檢校司徒。
units.en: During Changxing and Qingtai he governed Chen, Huai, and Ci prefectures in succession and was further promoted to Acting Minister of Works.
units.literal: During Changxing and Qingtai he governed Chen, Huai, and Ci prefectures in succession and was further promoted to Acting Minister of Works.

units.zh: 高祖即位，授蔡州刺史，歲餘，卒於郡，時年三十五。
units.en: When Gaozu took the throne he was made prefect of Cai; after more than a year he died in the prefecture at the age of thirty-five.
units.literal: When Gaozu took the throne he was made prefect of Cai; after more than a year he died in the prefecture at the age of thirty-five.

units.zh: 贈太保。
units.en: He was posthumously honored as Grand Guardian.
units.literal: He was posthumously honored as Grand Guardian.

units.zh: 光輔以功臣子，歷數郡皆無濫政，竟善終於官，雖享年不永，亦可嘉也。
units.en: As the son of a meritorious minister, Guangfu held several prefectures and never misgoverned; he ended his life well in office, and though his years were not long, his conduct is praiseworthy.
units.literal: As the son of a meritorious minister, Guangfu held several prefectures and never misgoverned; he ended his life well in office, and though his years were not long, his conduct is praiseworthy.

units.zh: 光輔有弟數人，光貞歷義、乾二州刺史，入為諸衛將軍。
units.en: Guangfu had several younger brothers: Guangzhen served as prefect of Yi and Qian in turn and later became a general of the guard armies at court.
units.literal: Guangfu had several younger brothers; Guangzhen served successively as prefect of Yi and Qian prefectures and entered court as a general of the guard armies.

units.zh: 光遜繼為蔡州刺史。
units.en: Guangxun succeeded him as prefect of Caizhou.
units.literal: Guangxun succeeded to the post and became prefect of Caizhou.

units.zh: 光贊任青州行軍司馬，及楊光遠叛滅，貶商州司馬，會赦征還，尋卒於家。
units.en: Guangzan served as campaign staff officer in Qingzhou; when Yang Guangyuan's rebellion was crushed he was demoted to staff officer of Shangzhou; recalled under an amnesty, he soon died at home.
units.literal: Guangzan served as campaign staff officer in Qingzhou; when Yang Guangyuan rebelled and was destroyed he was demoted to staff officer of Shangzhou; when an amnesty was proclaimed he was recalled, and soon died at home.

units.zh: 符彥饒，唐莊宗朝蕃漢總管存審之第二字也。
units.en: Fu Yanrao was the second son of Li Cunjian, the overall commander of tribal and Han forces under Emperor Zhuangzong of Tang.
units.literal: Fu Yanrao was the second son of Cunjian, the overall tribal-and-Han commander of the Tang Zhuangzong court.

units.zh: 存審，《唐書》有傳。
units.en: His father Cunjian is given a full biography in the 《Book of Tang》.
units.literal: Cunjian has a biography in the 《Book of Tang》.

units.zh: 彥饒少驍勇，能騎射。
units.en: In youth Yanrao was bold and skilled in riding and archery.
units.literal: Yanrao in youth was valiant and brave and skilled in riding and archery.

units.zh: 唐天祐十五年冬，莊宗與梁大戰於胡柳陂，彥饒與弟彥圖俱從其父血戰，有功，莊宗壯之，因用為騎將。
units.en: In winter of Tianyou 15 Zhuangzong fought a great battle with the Liang at Huliupo; Yanrao and his brother Yantu fought alongside their father with distinction; Zhuangzong was impressed and made Yanrao a cavalry officer.
units.literal: In winter of the fifteenth year of Tang Tianyou, Zhuangzong fought a great battle with Liang at Huliupo; Yanrao and his younger brother Yantu both followed their father in bloody combat with merit; Zhuangzong admired this and therefore employed him as a cavalry officer.

units.zh: 同光中，以功授曹州刺史。
units.en: During Tongguang he was made prefect of Caozhou for his service.
units.literal: In the Tongguang era, for merit he was made prefect of Caozhou.

units.zh: 明宗即位，改刺沂州。
units.en: When Mingzong took the throne he was transferred to Yizhou.
units.literal: When Mingzong took the throne he was transferred to govern Yizhou.

units.zh: 天成中，屯守梁園，會起軍北戍塞下，時有偏校以宣武之帥，迫彥饒為之，彥饒紿許其請，明日，殺為惡者奏之，時人嘉其方略。
units.en: During Tiancheng he was garrisoned at Liangyuan; when troops were mobilized for the northern frontier, a deputy officer tried to use the Xuanwu commander to force Yanrao to join a plot; Yanrao feigned agreement, then the next day killed the ringleader and reported him—contemporaries praised his shrewdness.
units.literal: In the Tiancheng era he was garrisoned at Liangyuan; when troops were raised to guard the northern frontier, a deputy officer used the commander of Xuanwu to force Yanrao to act for him; Yanrao pretended to agree, and the next day killed the ringleader and reported it—people of the time praised his stratagem.

units.zh: 長興中，為金州防禦使，為政甚有民譽，其後略遷節鎮。
units.en: During Changxing he was defense commissioner of Jinzhou and governed with a strong reputation among the people; he was later transferred among frontier commands.
units.literal: In the Changxing era he was defense commissioner of Jinzhou; his governance won great popular esteem, and afterward he was gradually transferred among military governorships.

units.zh: 天福初，為滑州節度使，累官至檢校太傅。
units.en: At the beginning of Tianfu he became military governor of Huazhou and rose to Acting Grand Tutor.
units.literal: At the beginning of Tianfu he was military governor of Huazhou and rose in office to Acting Grand Tutor.

units.zh: 二年七月，範延光據鄴都叛，朝廷遣侍衛馬軍都指揮使白奉進率騎軍三千，屯於州之開元寺。
units.en: In the seventh month of the second year Fan Yanguang rebelled and held Ye; the court sent palace guard cavalry commander Bai Fengjin with three thousand horsemen to encamp at the Kaiyuan Temple in Huazhou.
units.literal: In the seventh month of the second year Fan Yanguang held Ye in rebellion; the court sent the palace guard cavalry commander Bai Fengjin to lead three thousand horsemen and encamp them at the Kaiyuan Temple in the prefecture.

units.zh: 一日，彥饒與奉進因事忿爭於牙署，事具奉進傳中。
units.en: One day Yanrao and Fengjin quarreled over a matter at headquarters; the full account is given in Fengjin's biography.
units.literal: One day Yanrao and Fengjin quarreled over a matter in the headquarters office; the affair is fully recorded in Fengjin's biography.

units.zh: 是時，奉進厲聲曰：「爾莫是與範延光同反耶？」
units.en: Fengjin shouted, "Are you not in league with Fan Yanguang's rebellion?"
units.literal: At that time Fengjin said in a harsh voice: "Are you not in rebellion together with Fan Yanguang?"

units.zh: 拂衣而起，彥饒不留，帳下介士大噪，擒奉進殺之。
units.en: He turned to leave; Yanrao did not stop him, but his guards raised an uproar, seized Fengjin, and killed him.
units.literal: He brushed his robe and rose; Yanrao did not detain him; the guards beneath his tent made a great uproar, seized Fengjin, and killed him.

units.zh: 奉進從騎散走，傳呼於外。
units.en: Fengjin's escort scattered and fled, spreading word of what had happened outside.
units.literal: Fengjin's escort horsemen scattered and fled, crying the news outside.

units.zh: 時步軍都校馬萬、次校盧順密聞奉進被害，即率其部眾攻滑之子城，執彥饒以出。
units.en: Infantry commander Ma Wan and deputy commander Lu Shunmi, hearing that Fengjin had been killed, at once led their troops against the inner city of Huazhou, seized Yanrao, and brought him out.
units.literal: At the time the infantry commander Ma Wan and deputy commander Lu Shunmi, hearing that Fengjin had been killed, immediately led their troops to attack the inner city of Huazhou, seized Yanrao, and brought him out.

units.zh: 遣裨校方太拘送闕下，行及赤岡南，高祖遣中使害於路左。
units.en: They sent deputy officer Fang Tai to escort him to the capital; south of Chigang the High Ancestor sent a palace envoy to execute him on the road.
units.literal: They sent deputy officer Fang Tai to escort him to court; when they reached south of Chigang, the High Ancestor dispatched a palace envoy to kill him on the roadside.

units.zh: 羅周敬，字尚素，鄴王紹威之弟三子也。
units.en: Luo Zhoujing, whose courtesy name was Shangsu, was the third son of Prince of Ye Shaowei.
units.literal: Luo Zhoujing, style name Shangsu, was the third son of Prince Ye Shaowei.

units.zh: 紹威，《梁書》有傳。
units.en: Shaowei has a biography in the 《Book of Liang》.
units.literal: Shaowei has a biography in the 《Book of Liang》.

units.zh: 周敬幼聰明，八歲學為詩，往往傳於人口，起家授檢校尚書、禮部員外郎。
units.en: Zhoujing was clever from childhood; at eight he began writing poetry, and his verses were often on people's lips; upon entering service he received the titles of Acting Director of the Imperial Secretariat and Vice Director of Rites.
units.literal: Zhoujing was clever from childhood; at eight he began to study poetry, and his verses often passed from mouth to mouth; upon entering service he was given Acting Director of the Imperial Secretariat and Vice Director of Rites.

units.zh: 梁乾化中，以兄周翰節制滑臺，卒於官，乃以周敬繼之，命為兩使留後，尋正授旄鉞，時年十歲。
units.en: During the Liang Ganhuo era his elder brother Zhouhan governed Huazhou and died in office; Zhoujing succeeded him as acting military governor and soon received the full commission—he was ten years old at the time.
units.literal: In the Liang Ganhuo era his elder brother Zhouhan governed Huatai and died in office; Zhoujing was then made his successor, appointed acting military governor of both circuits, and soon given the full commission—he was ten years old at the time.

units.zh: 未幾，改授許州節度使，繼加檢校尚書左僕射。
units.en: Before long he was transferred to military governor of Xuzhou and given the additional title of Acting Left Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat.
units.literal: Before long he was transferred to military governor of Xuzhou and further given Acting Left Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat.

units.zh: 逾三年，征授秘書監、檢校司空、駙馬都尉，尚梁普安公主，旋移光祿卿。
units.en: After three years he was summoned to court as Director of the Secretariat, Acting Minister of Works, and Commander of the Imperial Sons-in-Law; he married Princess Pu'an of Liang and was soon made Director of the Imperial Banquets.
units.literal: After more than three years he was summoned and made Director of the Secretariat, Acting Minister of Works, and Commander of the Imperial Sons-in-Law; he married Princess Pu'an of Liang and was soon transferred to Director of the Imperial Banquets.

units.zh: 莊宗即位，歷左右金吾大將軍。
units.en: When Zhuangzong took the throne he served in turn as Grand General of the Left and Right Golden Crow Armies.
units.literal: When Zhuangzong took the throne he served successively as Grand General of the Left and Right Golden Crow Armies.

units.zh: 初，唐天祐中，紹威嘗建第於洛陽福善裏，及莊宗入洛，以梁租庸使趙巖宅賜明宗。
units.en: Earlier, during Tang Tianyou, Shaowei had built a mansion in Fushan Lane in Luoyang; when Zhuangzong entered Luoyang he gave Mingzong the residence of the Liang rent-and-corvée commissioner Zhao Yan.
units.literal: Earlier, in Tang Tianyou, Shaowei had built a mansion in Fushan Lane in Luoyang; when Zhuangzong entered Luoyang he gave the residence of the Liang commissioner for rent and corvée Zhao Yan to Mingzong.

units.zh: 同光中，明宗在洛，以趨內稍遠，乃召周敬議易其第，周敬諾之。
units.en: During Tongguang Mingzong was in Luoyang; finding the ride to court somewhat long, he asked Zhoujing to exchange residences, and Zhoujing agreed.
units.literal: In the Tongguang era Mingzong was in Luoyang; because the journey to the palace was somewhat far, he summoned Zhoujing to discuss exchanging residences, and Zhoujing agreed.

units.zh: 後明宗即位，一日夢中見一人，儀形瑰秀，若素識者，夢中問曰：「此得非前宅主羅氏子？」
units.en: Later, after Mingzong took the throne, he dreamed one day of a man of splendid bearing who seemed familiar; in the dream he asked, "Could this be the son of the Luo family, the former owner of the house?"
units.literal: Later, when Mingzong took the throne, one day in a dream he saw a man of splendid and handsome bearing who seemed someone he had long known; in the dream he asked: "Could this not be the son of the Luo family, the former owner of the house?"

units.zh: 及寤，訪其子孫，左右對曰：「周敬見列明廷。」
units.en: When he awoke he asked after the family's descendants; his attendants replied, "Zhoujing is now at court."
units.literal: When he awoke he inquired after his descendants; attendants replied: "Zhoujing is now at court in the bright hall."

units.zh: 召至，果符夢中所見。
units.en: He was summoned, and indeed matched the man in the dream.
units.literal: He was summoned, and indeed matched what had been seen in the dream.

units.zh: 明宗謂侍臣曰：「朕不欲使大勛之後久無土地。」
units.en: Mingzong told his attendants, "I do not wish the descendants of great merit to remain landless for long."
units.literal: Mingzong said to his attendants: "I do not wish the descendants of great merit to long go without lands."

units.zh: 因授同州節度使，加檢校太保。
units.en: He therefore appointed him military governor of Tongzhou and gave him the additional title of Acting Grand Guardian.
units.literal: He therefore made him military governor of Tongzhou and added Acting Grand Guardian.

units.zh: 長興中，入為左監門衛上將軍，四遷諸衛上將軍。
units.en: During Changxing he entered court as Grand General of the Left Gate Guard Army and was transferred four times among the guard army commands.
units.literal: In the Changxing era he entered court as Grand General of the Left Gate Guard Army and was transferred four times among the grand generals of the guard armies.

units.zh: 天福二年卒，時年三十二。
units.en: He died in the second year of Tianfu at the age of thirty-two.
units.literal: He died in the second year of Tianfu, aged thirty-two.

units.zh: 贈太傅。
units.en: He was posthumously honored as Grand Tutor.
units.literal: He was posthumously made Grand Tutor.

units.zh: 鄭琮，太原人也。
units.en: Zheng Cong was a native of Taiyuan.
units.literal: Zheng Cong was a native of Taiyuan.

units.zh: 始事唐武皇為五院軍小校，屢有軍功。
units.en: He began by serving Tang's Martial Emperor as a minor officer in the Five-Courts Army and repeatedly won military merit.
units.literal: He began by serving Tang's Martial Emperor as a minor officer in the Five-Courts Army and repeatedly won military merit.

units.zh: 莊宗在河上，為馬步都虞候。
units.en: When Zhuangzong was on the Yellow River he served as overall tribal-and-Han cavalry and infantry adjutant.
units.literal: When Zhuangzong was on the Yellow River he served as overall tribal-and-Han cavalry and infantry adjutant.

units.zh: 戎伍之事，一睹不忘，凡所詰問，應答如流，故所在知名。
units.en: In military matters he forgot nothing at a glance; whenever questioned he answered fluently, and so became known wherever he served.
units.literal: In military matters he forgot nothing at a glance; whenever questioned he answered fluently, and so became known wherever he served.

units.zh: 唐同光末，從明宗伐魏州，時軍情有變，明宗退守魏縣，未知趨向。
units.en: At the end of Tongguang of Tang he followed Mingzong in the campaign against Weizhou; when army morale shifted Mingzong withdrew to defend Wei County, uncertain where to turn.
units.literal: At the end of Tongguang of Tang he followed Mingzong in the campaign against Weizhou; when army morale shifted Mingzong withdrew to defend Wei County, uncertain where to turn.

units.zh: 安重誨將征兵於四方，琮在帳前，歷數諸道屯軍及主將姓名，附口傳檄，相次而至。
units.en: An Chonghui was about to levy troops from all directions; Cong stood before the tent, itemizing the garrison forces of each circuit and the names of their commanders, transmitting edicts orally one after another until they arrived in succession.
units.literal: An Chonghui was about to levy troops from all directions; Cong stood before the tent, itemizing the garrison forces of each circuit and the names of their commanders, transmitting edicts orally one after another until they arrived in succession.

units.zh: 明宗即位，嘉其功，授防州刺史，秩滿，父老請留。
units.en: When Mingzong took the throne he praised Cong's merit, made him prefect of Fang, and when his term ended the elders asked that he remain.
units.literal: When Mingzong took the throne he praised Cong's merit, made him prefect of Fang, and when his term ended the elders asked that he remain.

units.zh: 三年八月，授左羽林統軍。
units.en: In the eighth month of the third year he was made overall commander of the Left Yulin Guard.
units.literal: In the eighth month of the third year he was made overall commander of the Left Yulin Guard.

units.zh: 唐長興二年二月，出刺武州。
units.en: In the second month of the second year of Changxing of Tang he went out to govern Wu Prefecture.
units.literal: In the second month of the second year of Changxing of Tang he went out to govern Wu Prefecture.

units.zh: 高祖即位，復居環衛。
units.en: When Gaozu took the throne Cong returned to palace guard service.
units.literal: When Gaozu took the throne Cong returned to palace guard service.

units.zh: 久之，以俸薄家貧，郁郁不得志。
units.en: After a long time, with slender salary and a poor household, he was depressed and unfulfilled.
units.literal: After a long time, with slender salary and a poor household, he was depressed and unfulfilled.

units.zh: 天福中，以疾終於官。
units.en: During Tianfu he died of illness in office.
units.literal: During Tianfu he died of illness in office.

units.zh: 贈司徒。
units.en: He was posthumously honored as Minister of Works.
units.literal: He was posthumously honored as Minister of Works.
